resources.string: In 782 BC king Argishti I of Urartu founded the Erebuni fortress on the Arin-Berd hill — the conventional founding date of Yerevan, confirmed by a cuneiform inscription found in excavations.
Erebuni 782 — a trilingual offline guide to the Urartian fortresses Erebuni and Teishebaini (Karmir Blur). Phase P1: theme engine with three historical skins and the localization scaffold.
